A breach can trigger a €1,000-€10,000 fine under Ley 7/2019 and can also create a contractual claim from the rental operator. If you want a car on the island, book directly with local operators such as Autos Ca Marí, Pitiusas Rent a Car, or Rent a Car San Fernando instead. Q2: What does the formentera.eco eco-tax cost in 2026? The formentera.eco fee for non-resident vehicles is €6 per day in June and September and €9 per day in July and August. The rule applies a minimum charge of five days, so a short stay can still cost €30 in June or September and €45 in July or August, even if you stay fewer nights. Non-resident cars entering from the mainland or Ibiza via ferry are subject to this system, while local rental fleets operating from La Savina port and the island’s quota-managed operators are treated differently under the current vehicle cap. Residents may still use authorised vehicles, but tourist agencies cannot legally market quads as a normal rental product during the restricted period. A permit-based exception does not change the general tourist ban, so booking an ATV as a standard holiday renter is not a realistic option. Q12: Where do I file a complaint if a rental company overcharges me? You should request the company's "hoja de reclamaciones" and submit the consumer copy to the official consumer authority if the matter is unresolved. Under Decree 46/2009 and the consumer framework used by the Direcció General de Consum, the form is a three-part document, and the complaint can be escalated to the Junta Arbitral de Consumo for free mediation; many cases are submitted online through the Govern de les Illes Balears system with SMS verification. faqs.a: No, tourist quad-bike rental is effectively closed in Formentera during the high season because formentera.eco sets a zero quota for tourist quads between 1 June and 30 September. The policy is tied to noise reduction, preservation of camí rural routes and rural access roads, and safety on narrow island lanes that also connect Cap de Barbaria, La Mola, and the Estany Pudent area. Residents may still use authorised vehicles, but tourist agencies cannot legally market quads as a normal rental product during the restricted period. A permit-based exception does not change the general tourist ban, so booking an ATV as a standard holiday renter is not a realistic option.

faqs.q: Q12: Where do I file a complaint if a rental company overcharges me?
faqs.a: You should request the company's "hoja de reclamaciones" and submit the consumer copy to the official consumer authority if the matter is unresolved. Under Decree 46/2009 and the consumer framework used by the Direcció General de Consum, the form is a three-part document, and the complaint can be escalated to the Junta Arbitral de Consumo for free mediation; many cases are submitted online through the Govern de les Illes Balears system with SMS verification. If the issue involves misleading advertising, refusal to refund, or abusive charges, the authority can review the case under regional consumer rules and, where relevant, vehicle-rental conduct standards supported by AEVAB, BALEVAL, and FENEVAL industry norms. If the dispute involves safety or criminal conduct, Spanish traffic and criminal law may also apply, including Article 379.2 Código Penal Español in serious road-offence cases.

article.headline: La Savina Port Car Rental Pickup Guide for 2026
article.description: Formentera has no airport; from Ibiza Airport (IBZ) take an 8 km taxi or L10 bus to Ibiza port, then a 30–45 min ferry with Baleària or Trasmapi to La Savina port for pickup.
article.body: Card not accepted at pickup Damage found after return Cleaning fee or sand charge Formentera has no airport, so every La Savina port car rental starts at the ferry terminal in La Savina, beside the PM-820 access road and the rotonda del Hospital approach. An Ibiza Airport (IBZ) transfer usually means an 8 km taxi or L10 bus ride to Ibiza port, then a 30–45 minute crossing with Baleària, Trasmapi, Aquabus, or Formentera Lines to La Savina port. The La Savina port pickup zone is compact, but the exact office matters because some operators use a port kiosk while others use a larger office a few minutes away on foot. In practice, the shortest queues are often at standalone offices rather than the small ferry-side desk, especially when the ferry from Ibiza arrives with a full load of passengers. Formotor operates multiple La Savina offices, including Vapor Manolito local 6, Carrer de s'Almadrava 11/13, and Venda des Brolls 2, plus a fifth office in Es Caló de Sant Agustí on PM-820 km 11.50. La Savina Rent a Car: La Savina Rent a Car lists S1 Oficina Central, S2 Puerto, and S3 Oficina in the La Savina area, with additional desks in Es Pujols for guests staying near the resorts. ProAuto Rent a Car: ProAuto Rent a Car has a port-facing presence in La Savina, and the operator also serves Es Pujols and several island hotels, which can reduce transfer friction for arriving ferry passengers. Autos Formentera: Autos Formentera keeps a front-line office at the port, which usually means a shorter walk than a shuttle-based pickup and a faster start for drivers heading to Sant Francesc Xavier or Es Pujols. Motorent Pujols: Motorent Pujols maintains offices in La Savina and Es Pujols, which is useful if your lodging is near the Estany Pudent area or the southbound route toward Migjorn. OK Mobility: OK Mobility operates year-round in La Savina port, and the chain is a practical backup for late arrivals because winter opening patterns are often more limited among smaller local operators. Esformentera is one of the clearer off-season options, with year-round coverage that can matter for November-to-April trips when island inventory is thinner. Autos Ca Marí: Autos Ca Marí is another locally verified year-round operator, and its availability can be useful for travellers heading onward to Cala Saona, Cap de Barbaria, or La Mola. Formentera Meharis: Formentera Meharis serves the island with compact vehicles that suit narrow camí rural access roads and short scenic transfers from La Savina to Pilar de la Mola. If your ferry docks at La Savina port during July or August, walk to the operator’s main office first and only use the kiosk if the reservation email specifically says the handover is there; this can cut the wait from 60–90 minutes to roughly 15–30 minutes. Queue length at La Savina port is mostly a function of arrival time, ferry load, and operator layout. On a Tuesday morning in May, a prebooked Fiat Panda or Nissan Micra can often be collected in about 15 minutes, while a Saturday midday arrival in August can push the wait to 60–90 minutes at the busiest kiosks. Direct operational point: A company desk at La Savina port is usually faster than a crowded ferry-exit counter, and a reservation with a named operator such as Formotor, ProAuto Rent a Car, or Autos Formentera reduces confusion at the handover stage. The practical rule is simple: reserve online, identify the exact office, and follow the operator’s pickup instructions rather than joining the first visible queue. This is especially important if your return timing is linked to ferry departure control, because passengers are often asked to arrive at the port about one hour before sailing in high season. La Savina port pickup details can help if you want a shorter on-foot transfer from the ferry exit. Formentera’s rental market changes materially outside peak season, and some companies close entirely from late October until Easter (“Setmana Santa”). That pattern matters because a closed office means no immediate counter support for a preauthorisation issue, a CDW claim, or a post-return cleaning dispute. Verified year-round operators commonly include OK Mobility, Esformentera, Autos Ca Marí, Motorent Pujols, Formotor, and Formentera Meharis. Smaller family-run fleets may suspend operations, and a traveller who arrives in January should assume limited staffing until confirmed otherwise by email.

article.headline: Auto huren op Formentera 2026 – Slim huren in La Savina
article.description: Auto huren op Formentera: huur ter plaatse in La Savina, niet een Ibiza-huurauto op de veerboot (boete tot €10.000). Alles over de formentera.eco-vergunning, kosten en stranden in 2026.
article.body: Hoe huur ik een auto op Formentera? Heb ik een formentera.eco-vergunning nodig als ik op het eiland huur? Mag ik mijn Ibiza-huurauto meenemen op de veerboot? Hoeveel kost de veerboot met auto? Welke auto kan ik het beste huren? Hoe kom ik bij Ses Illetes? Formentera heeft geen vliegveld: je komt per veerboot vanaf Ibiza aan in La Savina, de enige haven. Huur je auto ter plaatse in La Savina en neem geen Ibiza-huurauto mee op de veerboot, want dat is verboden (boete EUR 1.000 tot 10.000, ANPR-camera's, vervallen verzekering). Een op het eiland gehuurde auto valt onder een aparte quota (2.268 auto's) en heeft geen formentera.eco-vergunning nodig; de verhuurder regelt dat en de milieutax zit al in de prijs. Voor je eigen meegebrachte auto geldt van 1 juni tot 30 september de formentera.eco-vergunning: 6 euro/dag (min 30) in juni/september en 9 euro/dag (min 45) in juli/augustus; elektrische auto's zijn 100% vrijgesteld, hybrides 50% korting; campers en quads zijn verboden. Verhuurders bij de haven zijn OK Mobility, Avis, ProAuto, EsFormentera en Formotor; minimumleeftijd 21 jaar met 2 jaar rijbewijs, creditcard verplicht voor de borg, eigen risico 500 tot 2.500 euro. Kies een klein model zoals een Fiat Panda. Het strand Ses Illetes kent een limiet van 384 auto's en een tol van 5 tot 7 euro (elektrisch gratis); de parkeerplaats is in de piek vaak voor 11:00 uur vol, neem anders bus L3 vanaf La Savina. In de dorpen geldt de blauwe zone (1,20 euro/uur, gratis tussen 14:00 en 16:00) en er zijn slechts twee tankstations aan de PM-820.

faqs.q: Mag ik mijn Ibiza-huurauto meenemen op de veerboot?
faqs.a: Nee, dit is ten strengste verboden. De Ibiza-verhuurders verbieden het in hun voorwaarden (verzekering vervalt, geen pechhulp) en Wet 7/2019 verbiedt extern gehuurde auto's. De ANPR-camera's in La Savina registreren je kenteken; de boete loopt op van €1.000 tot €10.000.

faqs.q: Heb ik een formentera.eco-vergunning nodig als ik op het eiland huur?
faqs.a: Nee. Huur je rechtstreeks bij een lokaal bedrijf in La Savina, dan hoef je geen vergunning aan te vragen en geen milieuheffing te betalen. Lokale huurauto's vallen onder een eilandquotum van 2.268 voertuigen; de kosten zitten al in je huurprijs.

faqs.q: Hoeveel kost de veerboot met auto?
faqs.a: Met je eigen particuliere auto kost een basisticket voor 2 volwassenen en 1 auto minimaal zo'n €37 enkele reis, oplopend tot €123 à €135 in het hoogseizoen. Het autovervoer wordt verzorgd door Baleària en Trasmapi; de boarding sluit 90 minuten voor vertrek.

faqs.q: Welke auto kan ik het beste huren op Formentera?
faqs.a: Een zo klein mogelijk model, zoals een Fiat Panda of Citroën C3. De wegen zijn smal en omzoomd met stenen muren en parkeerplekken zijn krap; grote auto's en SUV's zijn onpraktisch en verhogen het risico op schade.

faqs.q: Hoe kom ik bij het strand Ses Illetes?
faqs.a: Ses Illetes ligt in het natuurgebied ses Salines en kent een limiet van 384 auto's per dag (IBIFOR, 10 mei–15 oktober). De tol is €5 tot €7 per auto (elektrisch gratis, hybride 50% korting). Omdat de parkeerplaats vaak voor 11:00 uur vol is, kun je ook bus L3 vanaf La Savina nemen.

faqs.q: Is er genoeg parkeergelegenheid op Formentera?
faqs.a: Parkeren is goed geregeld maar schaars in de zomer. In de dorpen geldt van mei tot oktober de blauwe zone (€1,20/uur, gratis tussen 14:00 en 16:00). Bij Cala Saona zijn er slechts 60 plaatsen; Migjorn heeft ruime gratis parkeerruimte. Bij La Savina is er een gratis overloopterrein op 700 m.
